P083.title: Study on the long-distance settlement threshold of high-speed railway subgrade based on vehicle responses
P083.authors: Z Li, W Wang, L Xu, J Xu
P083.label: Li等（2024）

complete_examples.text: Based on the analysis results, the Wavelet decomposition technique is applied to extract the low-frequency components of vehicle responses excited by the additional deformation of rails induced by the long-distance subgrade settlement.

The novelty of this work lies on the analysis of VTS dynamic interaction subject to a long-distance subgrade settlement through a Green’s function-based hybrid dynamic model, and by introducing the time-frequency combined technique, the low-frequency components of vehicle vibrations excited by the settlement are extracted and associated to the settlement characteristics.
